recipes.name: Breakfast Dessert Pasta from Elf
instructions: Boil water and cook spaghetti according to package. - Spaghetti
Toss pasta in tomato sauce. - Tomato sauce

Top pasta with a handful of chocolate chips and a handful of M&Ms. Crumble the fudge poptart on top. Top the pasta with a handful of marshmallows, a glug of syrup, some caramel sauce, and some chocolate sauce. - Chocolate chips - M&Ms - 1 fudge Pop Tart - Marshmallows - Maple syrup - Chocolate sauce - Caramel sauce
In a pan, heat tomato sauce over medium-high heat until bubbling.
Salt and boil water. Add pasta to water. Cook the pasta so it is slightly underdone. - pinch A of salt - Spaghetti - Tomato sauce

Drain pasta and add to sauce. Give it a good flip and add butter. Melt and incorporate butter. Drizzle in some olive oil and toss to combine. Plate and enjoy. - 1 tbsp butter - A drizzle of olive oil - Tomato sauce
